title: Login
description: Enter your username and password provided by admin to access the system.
more: If you forget your password, contact the system administrator to reset it.

title: Add Reservation
description: Go to 'Add Reservation' and fill in guest details.
more: Ensure the room type is available before saving.

title: Display Reservation
description: Enter reservation number to view full details of a booking.
more: You can also search by guest name if reservation number is unknown.
